name: race-assets
description: Procedural asset set for a small arcade racing game (stylised-realistic, bright daytime)

conventions.normal_maps: tangent space, OpenGL / glTF convention (+Y up)
conventions.colliders: hidden via KHR_node_visibility + extras.collider + invisible MASK material

car.origin: ground level, centre of the wheelbase (midway between front and rear axle), centred left/right

wheel_rotation.forward_rolling: rotate about local +X by -distance/wheel_radius radians (top of the wheel moves towards -Z)
wheel_rotation.steering: rotate front wheel nodes about local +Y; positive = steer left
wheel_rotation.note: all four wheel nodes have identity rotation; left wheels use a mirrored mesh (wheel_left)

metrics.centre_of_mass_note: relative to the car origin, in car-local axes

car.variant_mechanism: KHR_materials_variants on the body paint primitive (default material car_paint_red); engines without the extension can swap the baseColorTexture of material car_paint_red to the variant's albedo_texture

brake_light.note: set emissiveFactor (and optionally KHR_materials_emissive_strength) at runtime when braking

track.race_direction: counter-clockwise seen from above; spawn/checkpoint empties face the race direction (local -Z)
track.distance_parameter: s = metres along the centreline from the start/finish line in race direction

features.note: wraps through s=0 (the start/finish line): from the final corner exit to the first corner
elevation varies -3.0 .. 10.0 m relative to the start line

col_barriers.description: closed walls on both sides of the circuit, 4 m high (visual barrier 1 m)

col_terrain.description: run-off (grass/gravel) between road edge and barriers, 3 cm below road level

nodes.collision_hiding: collision nodes carry KHR_node_visibility {visible:false}, extras.collider=true and use material collider_invisible (baseColor alpha 0, alphaMode MASK) so they never render even in engines that ignore the extension; engines should not render them at all

track.spawn_note: position = car origin (ground level, wheelbase centre); rotation turns the car's -Z forward into the race direction
track.checkpoint_note: cp_00 is the start/finish line. Trigger box: size [x across track, y up, z along track] in the empty's local frame, centred at box_center_local (box bottom on the road surface). A lap counts when cp_01..cp_NN were passed in order and then cp_00 is crossed.

racing_line.format: [{x,y,z,speed_kmh}] world space, y on the road surface, first point at the start/finish line, closed loop (last point connects to the first)

minimap.formula: u_px = x * pixels_per_metre + offset_px[0]; v_px = z * pixels_per_metre + offset_px[1] (world -Z = north = image up)

track.texture_reference: track.glb and scenery.glb reference their textures as external files (../textures/*.png)

scenery.usage: track.glb already contains every scenery instance baked into the scenery_* nodes (merged by material, static). For GPU instancing instead: hide/skip the scenery_* nodes of track.glb and instantiate the proto_* nodes of scenery.glb with the transforms below (glTF TRS, world space).
scenery.instance_color_tint_note: optional RGB multiplier applied to COLOR_0 for variation (trees)
scenery.brands_note: all brand names are invented for this project
scenery.collision: scenery has no colliders: everything stands behind the barriers (cones are decorative, on the run-off)

environment_lighting.note: pre-blurred low-res version for IBL / ambient

sky.mapping: u = 0.5 + atan2(dir.z, dir.x) / (2*pi); v = 0.5 - asin(dir.y) / pi (v=0 top). Identical to three.js equirectangular mapping and Blender's default after glTF import; image centre = +X

sun.direction_note: unit vector from the scene TOWARDS the sun (world, glTF axes)
sun.light_direction_note: direction the light travels (for directional lights)
sun.azimuth_note: measured in the x-z plane from +X towards +Z

all.usage: car paint livery (u around body section, v along body)
car paint livery (u around body section, v along body)
car paint livery (u around body section, v along body)
car paint livery (u around body section, v along body)

countdown.description: Full countdown: 3 short beeps 1 s apart + 1 long beep at t=3 s

engine_crossfade.note: pitch each layer by current_rpm / base_rpm and crossfade between neighbours

ui.icon_style: flat, white (#FFFFFF) on transparent, 24x24 SVG view box

default.applies_to: all models, textures, sky, audio, icons, data and previews
default.author: procedurally generated by the scripts in /asset-src of this repository
